summary: iter167 Bank Reconciliation admin UI — full frontend E2E via Playwright. All 4 tabs (Import statement / Transactions / History & files / Rules), sidebar entry (admin-nav-reconciliation), CSV import flow, manual_review candidate confirmation, rollback with reason validation, manual link dialog, history download, and config validation flow all work as specified. Backend regression spot-check on 6 GET endpoints returned 200 for admin.

minor.issue: Employee session_token (test_session_employee_X, no 'reconciliation' permission) returns 200 instead of 403. Main agent said pytest covers permission gates as passing — may be because default employee role in this env has the reconciliation permission granted. Worth confirming: the fine-grained 'reconciliation' permission is actually enforced (not just tenant/role scope). Sidebar hides the entry client-side but backend does not deny.

issues: Radix Dialog console warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to recon-candidates-dialog, recon-rollback-dialog, recon-link-dialog for a11y.

Error toast text on invalid save is hardcoded Spanish ('El umbral de revisión debe ser menor que el umbral automático.') even though this admin uses English UI (preferred_language=en). Localize the 422 message via i18n. The valid-save success toast IS localized ('Rules saved').

action_items: Add DialogDescription to reconciliation dialogs (a11y, silences Radix warnings).
Localize backend 422 message for manual_review_score >= auto_match_score, or i18n on frontend by mapping the error code (not the text).
Verify server-side enforcement of the 'reconciliation' permission (employee session hit /summary with 200) — if permission-gating is by design granted to all employees in this env, ignore.
critical_code_review_comments: ConfigTab: hardcoded lists of field names — fine for now; ensure they stay in sync with backend Pydantic model.
TransactionsTab.jsx is ~340 lines with three dialogs inline — approaching complexity threshold; consider extracting dialogs into sibling components if it grows further.
HistoryTab download uses URL.createObjectURL but never revokes when user cancels the temporary anchor; low-risk memory leak on repeated downloads.
